title: Area laws and tensor networks for two-dimensional gapped systems

result.label: Area laws and tensor networks for two-dimensional gapped systems
result.statement: Proves an entropy area law for unique ground states of finite-range Hamiltonians on arbitrary finite induced square-lattice domains, using only a uniform full-system spectral gap and bounds on the local interactions. On open L L squares, uniformly gapped nearest-neighbor ground states also admit projected entangled-pair state approximations with polynomial bond dimension and global vector error at most L −1 .
